actions.command: bash -c 'nmcli radio wifi | grep -q enabled && nmcli radio wifi off || nmcli radio wifi on'
actions.update-command: bash -c 'nmcli radio wifi | grep -q enabled && echo true || echo false'

actions.command: bash -c 'busctl get-property org.bluez /org/bluez/hci0 org.bluez.Adapter1 Powered | grep -q true && busctl set-property org.bluez /org/bluez/hci0 org.bluez.Adapter1 Powered b false || { rfkill unblock bluetooth; busctl set-property org.bluez /org/bluez/hci0 org.bluez.Adapter1 Powered b true; }'
actions.update-command: bash -c 'busctl get-property org.bluez /org/bluez/hci0 org.bluez.Adapter1 Powered | grep -q true && echo true || echo false'

actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && (systemd-inhibit --what=idle:sleep --who=swaync --why=manual-inhibit sleep infinity & echo $! > /tmp/swaync-idle-inhibit.pid) || (kill $(cat /tmp/swaync-idle-inhibit.pid) 2>/dev/null; rm -f /tmp/swaync-idle-inhibit.pid)'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[[ -f /tmp/swaync-idle-inhibit.pid ]] && kill -0 $(cat /tmp/swaync-idle-inhibit.pid) 2>/dev/null && echo true || echo false'
